steps.name: canonical-50-responsive-E2E-no-snapshot-updates
steps.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"
echo 'VISUAL_50_SINGLE_WORKER'
LCL_E2E_PORT=5292 LCL_VISUAL_CONTRACT=1 pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/mobile/playwright.config.ts --workers=1 --reporter=json >/tmp/shelly-ionic-183-full-e2e.json 2>/tmp/shelly-ionic-183-full-e2e.err || {
 echo 'CANONICAL_E2E_FAILED'
 python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-183-full-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
try:
 j=json.loads(s[s.index('{'):]);print('STATS',j.get('stats'))
 def walk(ss):
  for su in ss:
   for sp in su.get('specs',[]):
    for t in sp.get('tests',[]):
     if t.get('status') not in ('expected','skipped'):
      print('FAIL',sp.get('title'),t.get('status'))
      for r in t.get('results',[]):
       if r.get('error'):print('ERROR',r['error'].get('message','')[:1200])
   walk(su.get('suites',[]))
 walk(j.get('suites',[]))
except Exception as e:print('PARSE_ERROR',str(e),s[-1200:])
PY
 tail -25 /tmp/shelly-ionic-183-full-e2e.err
 exit 50
}
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-183-full-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
stats=json.loads(s[s.index('{'):])['stats']
print('E2E_FINAL_STATS',stats)
assert stats['expected']==50 and stats['unexpected']==0 and stats['skipped']==0 and stats['flaky']==0
PY
echo 'CANONICAL_50_50_PASS'
echo 'WORKTREE';git status --short
uptime
